# Setup

This script must be run before all other scripts.
It loads required packages, defines file paths, color palettes,
sample order, and the central `loadAlignedBamTable()` function.

---

## 1. Required Packages

```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(GenomicAlignments)
library(Rsamtools)
library(Biostrings)
library(ShortRead)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readODS)
library(gt)
library(tibble)
library(parallel)
```

---

## 2. File Paths
# Adjust these paths before running

```{r paths}
base_dir    <- "/path/"                         
fastq_dir   <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
bam_dir     <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
ref_dir     <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
ddpcr_file  <- file.path(base_dir, "ods_path")
output_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
blast_dir   <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
cont_dir    <- file.path(base_dir, "path")
```

---

## 3. Sample Order and Color Palette

```{r colors}
# Sample order (consistent across all plots)
sample_levels <- c("lambda", "wt-fragments", "M1", "M2", "M3", "M4")

# Color palette (consistent across all plots)
sample_colors <- c(
  "lambda"       = "#66CDAA",
  "wt-fragments" = "#DEB887",
  "M1"           = "#FFB90F",
  "M2"           = "#FF7F00",
  "M3"           = "#CD2626",
  "M4"           = "#8B4500"
)
```

---

## 4. Custom ggplot2 Theme

```{r theme}
theme_publication <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title   = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "black")
    )
}
```

---

## 5. Helper Function: loadAlignedBamTable()

Reads a BAM file and returns an S4 object (`AlignedBamTable`) containing:
- `path`: file path
- `raw`: GAlignments object
- `table`: data.frame with per-read metrics (alignment position, length, quality, CIGAR)

```{r load_function}
# Define S4 class
setClass(
  "AlignedBamTable",
  slots = list(
    path  = "character",
    raw   = "GAlignments",
    table = "data.frame"
  )
)

# Load BAM file and compute per-read metrics
loadAlignedBamTable <- function(file) {

  param    <- ScanBamParam(what = c("qual"))
  bam      <- readGAlignments(file, param = param)
  barcode_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  # Compute mean Phred quality score per read (averaged on linear probability scale)
  qual_list <- mcols(bam)$qual
  mean_qual <- vapply(qual_list, function(q) {
    if (is.null(q) || length(q) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    scores    <- as.integer(q) - 33L       # ASCII → Phred
    probs     <- 10^(-scores / 10)         # Phred → error probability
    mean_prob <- mean(probs)               # mean on linear scale
    -10 * log10(mean_prob)                 # back to Phred
  }, numeric(1))

  # Build per-read table
  tbl <- tibble(
    barcode    = barcode_name,
    qname      = names(bam),
    flag       = mcols(bam)$flag,
    seqnames   = as.character(seqnames(bam)),
    strand     = as.character(strand(bam)),
    aln_start  = start(bam),
    aln_end    = end(bam),
    aln_length = width(bam),
    mapq       = mcols(bam)$mapq,
    cigar      = cigar(bam),
    read_len   = qwidth(bam),
    mean_qual  = mean_qual
  ) |>
    mutate(strand = ifelse(strand == "+", "1", "-1"))

  new(
    "AlignedBamTable",
    path  = file,
    raw   = bam,
    table = as.data.frame(tbl)
  )
}
```
